A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MRS.Q study. Their complete main texts, equations, figures, tables, and appendices are readable and support reliable comparison across renumbering and relocation.

before.justification: v1 reports original continuous-control experiments, model and value-error measurements, and MRS.Q ablations in Sections 4–6 and Appendices B–C.

after.justification: v2 retains these empirical results and adds TD-MPC2 ensemble experiments and computational-cost measurements in Appendices B and D.

M1.justification: Section 6.2 adds an adaptation applying the minimum over ten value functions to TD-MPC2. The principal MRS.Q algorithm, architecture, losses, MPC procedure, and hyperparameters remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same five Gym tasks, 28 DMC tasks, and 14 HumanoidBench tasks under both hand configurations. The added analyses reuse existing environments; reach-task exclusion from aggregates was already documented in v1.

E2.justification: The main performance-baseline roster is unchanged. The new computational-cost comparison introduces MR.Q with ten value functions as an additional control alongside MR.Q and TD-MPC2 against MRS.Q.

E3.justification: Appendix B introduces a wall-clock evaluation on HalfCheetah-v4 for one million steps, using consistent hardware with torch.compile disabled. The new TD-MPC2 ablation evaluates a ten-critic configuration. Existing benchmark budgets, normalization, and evaluation schedules are retained.

E4.justification: v2 adds a targeted generalization test of ensemble minimization on TD-MPC2 across all four benchmark configurations, plus an analysis separating ensemble and MPC computational costs. The existing MRS.Q ablations and action-variation analysis remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Figure 3 loses its visible standard-deviation error bars, although its caption still describes them. New TD-MPC2 ablation tables specify ten seeds, while Table 3 and Appendix A.4 still describe five-seed ablations; this discrepancy is unresolved. Existing bootstrap reporting procedures are otherwise retained.

E6.justification: TD-MPC2's Gym aggregate changes from 0.38 [0.26, 0.51] to 0.41 [0.27, 0.57], with other aggregate confidence bounds revised; unchanged per-task scores support the corrected mean. v2 adds TD-MPC2 Min (10) results and runtime measurements. Existing MRS.Q scores and ablation results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The absorbing-chain construction, search-success probability, and mathematical argument are unchanged. Equation 5 explicitly writes the existing two-critic target, while other equation and policy-notation edits clarify previously described procedures rather than introduce new theory.

C1.justification: The abstract refines its mitigation claim from distribution shift to overestimation bias and explicitly identifies ensemble minimization as the effective technique. The central claims about model accuracy being insufficient and MRS.Q's benchmark performance remain intact.

C2.justification: v2 attributes most computational overhead to MPC, expands discussion of policy-guided search limitations, and removes the limitation that the extension is specific to MR.Q. It also drops v1's caution that different training distributions complicate comparisons of model accuracy.

D1.justification: v2 adds a MRS.Q code repository link, measured training times, compilation controls, and an explicit statement that evaluation excludes exploration noise. Appendix A's architecture code, hyperparameters, baseline commits, and error-measurement sampling procedure are otherwise retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds Palenicek et al. (2023) and Lan et al. (2020), removes Hiraoka et al. (2021) and Kuznetsov et al. (2020), and refocuses the ensemble discussion on search-induced overestimation. Several other reference changes merely update publication metadata.

P1.justification: Several paragraphs in Sections 2–5 are rewritten or expanded, Section 4.3 gains method-specific bullets, and evaluation-protocol and computational-cost passages are added. The impact statement is replaced, but the main section sequence and overall narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 3 replaces clipped bars with a broken-axis marker plot, numerical annotations, and per-method performance-sign rows. Table 3 gains an algorithm column; a runtime table and four TD-MPC2 ablation tables are added. Existing learning-curve graphics are unchanged.

improvement.justification: The TD-MPC2 transfer experiment, computational-cost analysis, code link, and corrected Gym aggregate provide useful additional support and transparency without changing the main findings. These gains are tempered by Figure 3's missing uncertainty bars despite its caption and inconsistent seed descriptions for the new ablations.
